name: wos-rewards-service
description: Cloudflare-hosted Discord service for registering Whiteout Survival players and processing gift codes.

scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-typegen:check && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p companion/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:worker && npm run test:companion
scripts.test:mvp: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/manual-code.test.ts test/manual-code-migration.test.ts test/staging-mvp.test.ts test/discord-live-delivery.test.ts && vitest run --config companion/vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:shuffle: npm run test:shuffle:worker && npm run test:shuffle:companion
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply STAGING_DB --local --env staging
scripts.test:probe: npm run probe:build && vitest run --config experiments/task12/vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:probe && npm run test && npm run test:shuffle && npm run validate
